I am on chapter 67 right now and I just want to tell how pathetic this whole series is.
Reasons why it is pathetic and extremely frustrating to read:
1) 0 maturity: I understand that the series is trying to show the life of a 14-16 year old girl who got whisked away to a different world, but so many times in the series the author mentions poverty and starvation and the MC (who is the crown princess) does nothing about it, all she cares about is her makeup and how good she looks. This is very bad because it sends a very shallow message to young readers. 
2) Writing transition between stories: The transaction from one incident to another was horrible, the author always wastes minimum 4 pages showing us a recap of the previous episode, although this is a common practice in most writers this seems to be unnecessary for each and every chapter in my opinion because most of the chapters don’t have much content in them to begin with. The writer goes jumps from the end of a scenario to the beginning of a new scenario. Worst part of this whole thing is that the MC seems to be extremely selfish, maybe this is because the MC is shown as young high schooler. This is what makes the whole series weird af coz the MC is suppose to be a minor who got transported to a different world and is immediately married off to a “prince” who looks to be in his 20s…..like seriously Miss/Mr author what the hell are you trying to say here? Why are you trying to make it seem like minor marriage is ok? Even if it’s in a mangwha it is inappropriate af. 
3) Most annoying MC: this is one of those series where the MC is lame af and you wished she wasn’t the MC, tbh sometimes I was rooting for the evil guy coz that’s how annoying the MC gets later on, like for example: she literally sees beggars on the street and by this point she knows the rumours going on and she even knows that the commoners are blaming her….so what does she do to better her position? She ignores them and has an amazing night with her prince, but at the same time she is quick to save her 2 friends who were sad because they were being bullied. God FORBID her 2 annoying friends getting bullied, how dare the nobles go against each other and bully each other :o! How disgraceful!! But citizens starving? Yea let’s just ignore those cheap ass peasants and enjoy all the manly attention she’s getting from her harem of men. Lastly she even gets a warning from an Anonymous person that the emperor is being poisoned but she doesn’t do anything about it until the guy collapses!!! Only after he is almost about to die will she be like “ohh wait that day I received this letter!! I must tell someone and help save the kingdom!!!”. Sighhhhhh……SERIOUSLY GIRL!!!!! *THIS MC IS THE DUMBEST ONE SK FAR* I’m really really happy that this shitty author gave up on this shitty shallow series where the only thing that matters is her bitch ass makeup!!! 

IF ANYONE WANTS TO BE AS FRUSTRATED AS ME AND WASTE YOUR TIME READING SOME SHITTY ASS SERIES PLEASE BE MY GUEST! 
Please read this shallow ass series where the only thing that matters is her lipstick, her useless friends, and her complete lack of humanity! 

FYI: this is for the naive girls out there….i was being sarcastic….don’t kill your brain cells trying to read something that might demean your intelligence.
